mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate being at or below 0.5% (a historically low level) compresses discount rates applied to equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS at or below 0.5% is associated with positive 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% over the past 3 months signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5% in the past 3 months
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rising above 0.5% in the past 3 months is associated with positive 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in private sector employment (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of UNRATE rising and PAYEMS declining is associated with positive 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 850 thousand units and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) is below 1.0% annualized, it signals weakening demand, increasing recession risk and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 850 and GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0% (annualized) over the past 6 months
failure_condition: The condition of HOUST < 850 and GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0% (annualized) is associated with positive 60-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 in the past month signals supply contraction, increasing recession risk and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 95.0 in the past month
failure_condition: INDPRO falling below 95.0 in the past month is associated with positive 5-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The industrial production index (INDPRO) being below 100.0 (a historically low level) signals supply contraction, increasing recession risk and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO below 100.0 is associated with positive 60-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 850 thousand units in the past month signals weakening housing demand, increasing recession risk and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 850 in the past month
failure_condition: HOUST falling below 850 in the past month is associated with positive 5-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) is at or above 7.0% and private sector employment (PAYEMS) growth is below 0.5% annualized, it signals a weak labor market, increasing recession risk and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE >= 7.0% and PAYEMS growth rate < 0.5% (annualized) over the past 6 months
failure_condition: The condition of UNRATE >= 7.0% and PAYEMS growth rate < 0.5% (annualized) is associated with positive 60-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
